On air, together

You walk into the studio at seven in last night's jacket and sit down at Marcus's glass desk. When you tell the city who you are, a small amber light comes on above the camera and ARGUS answers for every word, the vault, the recording, the night you stood in the dark and believed it. Your record clears before the broadcast ends. When the camera light goes off, Marcus squeezes your hand, and above the lens the amber light blinks once.You walk into the studio at seven in last night's jacket and sit down at Marcus's glass desk.
